blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
In supply chain, numbers are everywhere. We have 200 bags, a lot of boxes and a few pallets. Quantifiers help us describe things without being too exact.

Some words are simple. We say "many boxes" or "a lot of boxes" for plural things. We use "a few" for a small number. We use "some" for affirmative sentences.

Today you learn 5 important words: amount, total, unit, piece and count. Good numbers make a good supply chain. We start slow. You can do it!

items.q: What is the text mainly about?
options: Numbers and quantifiers in supply chain
items.why: O texto fala de números e quantificadores no estoque.

items.q: How many pallets does the text mention?
items.why: "a lot of boxes and a few pallets" — poucos pallets.

items.q: According to the text, we use "a few" for…
items.why: "We use 'a few' for a small number."

items.q: The text suggests that good numbers are…
options: important for a good supply chain
items.why: Inferência: "Good numbers make a good supply chain" — os números são importantes.

items.q: The writer would most likely DISAGREE with this idea:
options: Numbers do not matter in supply chain.
items.why: Inferência: o texto todo diz que os números importam, então discordaria dessa frase.

blocks.instruction: Ouça o colega no estoque. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! Welcome to the team. My name is Paulo. Today we do a stock count together. It is easy, don't worry. I will show you, step by step.

Look at this shelf. Here we have some boxes. Let's count them together. One, two, three... we have ten boxes. Good job. Now write "ten" on the sheet, next to the word "boxes".

Next, the bags. We have a lot of bags here, maybe fifty. Please check again later. And we have a few pallets, only three. Not many. Now, please count each unit. One unit is one single item, not the full box.

Remember two words. The amount is the quantity of one item. The total is the sum of all units together. When you finish, we add the numbers and we get the total. So, the total today is ten boxes, fifty bags, and three pallets.

Take your time. Count slow, count right. A good count helps the whole supply chain. Numbers are everywhere in our work. You can do it. Let's start with this shelf now!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What do they do together today?
items.why: "Today we do a stock count together."

items.q: How many boxes are on the shelf?
items.why: "we have ten boxes."

items.q: What is the total for the day?
options: Ten boxes, fifty bags, and three pallets
items.why: "the total today is ten boxes, fifty bags, and three pallets."

items.q: The speaker says "count slow, count right." This suggests that…
options: being correct is more important than being fast
speed is more important than being correct
the new person should not count
items.why: Inferência: ele valoriza o acerto, não a pressa.

items.q: How does the speaker feel about the new team member?
items.why: Inferência: "Welcome", "don't worry", "You can do it" — tom amigável e encorajador.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "What is the amount of coffee in the box?" Amount means…
items.why: Amount = quantidade.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We add all the bags and we get the ___."
items.why: Total = a soma de tudo.

items.q: "Please take one unit from the shelf." A unit is…
items.why: Unit = uma única unidade, um item.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "This machine has a broken ___, so it does not work."
items.why: Piece = peça, uma parte de algo.

items.q: "Let's do a count of the boxes." A count is…
items.why: Count = a contagem, a ação de contar.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can you count on me? Yes, I will help you." To count on means to…
items.why: Count on = contar com, confiar em alguém.

items.q: "The manager will sign off on the numbers." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "Let's add up all the units." To add up means to…
items.why: Add up = somar, juntar os números.

items.q: "We are running out of boxes." This means we…
items.why: Run out of = ficar sem, acabar o estoque de algo.

items.q: "Please fill in the number on the sheet." To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher (um formulário, uma folha).
